tasks.gr7-energy-transfer-heat-and-motion-t3: Topic: Energy transfer, heat and motion. Cover kinetic and potential energy, conduction, convection, radiation, insulation, and efficiency. Ask Grade 7 learners to compare transfer pathways, interpret energy-flow situations, and apply ideas to everyday thermal and motion contexts.
tasks.gr7-mechanical-systems-and-control-t3: Topic: Mechanical systems and control. Cover levers, gears, pulleys, linkages, motion conversion, mechanical advantage, and systems thinking. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify mechanisms, predict movement and force changes, and evaluate simple control-system designs.
tasks.gr7-national-electricity-grid-t3: Topic: The national electricity supply system. Cover the grid from energy source to turbine to generator to wires to home, renewable and non-renewable sources, dynamos, and saving electricity at home. Ask Grade 7 learners to order the steps and explain energy transfers.
